top.line: Six people and around 250 agents, ten days at Web Summit: the map, and the series that will tell each part.
top.para: A team operating system, a newsroom, a storm site, a fringe guide, a rating standard, native apps and the tools to run them: about 20,000 commits, 224 sessions, more than 60 at once at the peak. The team, the timeline, the numbers, a collage, and thirteen articles to come.

in-short.line: Six people, around 250 agents, what we built, the scale, and this map.
in-short.para: Each part gets its own article.

team.line: Dinis Cruz, Angelo Leggio, Vicky Wang, Silvio Switha, José Bota and Indi Gupte, each with their own agents and conductor.
team.para: Agents carry their person's name, so every commit says whose agent made it.

timeline.line: From MeetScribe on 3 November to the final hold on 12 November and VoiceDebrief on the 13th.
timeline.para: The Big Stop on 9 November; Storm Charles and the cancelled Day 2 on the 10th; the storm swarm and the fringe guide on the 11th.

numbers.line: About 20,000 commits, 224 sessions, more than 60 at once, around 250 agents.
numbers.para: Storm Charles at 2,618 pages and 3.84 billion tokens; four iOS apps and an Android app; dollars are API-equivalent.

series.line: Thirteen articles, published one at a time and linked here as they go live.
series.para: Plus six already published from the same ten days.

limits.line: Counts depend on how you count; the peak is an upper bound; dollars are API-equivalent.

sources.line: The repositories behind each site and the session list, read 13 November 2026.
